notes: Both numeral/quantifier chains (nine tribes, half tribe) are construct + articled rectum, so each written the goes to the article morpheme and the construct noun stays bare (rule 29).
The two object markers and the resumptive suffix are the verse's only unrepresented source units apart from the lamed of lemor.
The single lamed takes both unto and to as one discontinuous unit under rule 25; the accepted note names the rule 33 alternative for the second word.
